text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—An Umamusume blessed by the heavens.
There probably really are people like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Natural talent and charm.
The circumstances of one's birth. It's all drama."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The way that person ran would eventually be spoken of as legend.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Once it becomes a legend, it can never be surpassed again. But――!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I don't intend to let this race be Oguri-san's last run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If it remains in people's memories like that, it's a loss...
Because then it'll just mean only the chosen ones ever win.
choice_data_list: The one who wasn't chosen wins?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As someone chasing after Oguri-san,
I will achieve the Grand Prix double fair and square!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I believe that ending it this way gives everyone the greatest amount of hope.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Through hard work, legends can be surpassed.
This is the ultimate stage to prove it!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll run just like always. My moves depend on the race.
I'll just bet on my intuition...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am Oguri-san's true successor.
In order to make what comes next…… the Mejiro Era.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trust this body. The body that holds every moment spent with Trainer!

Senior Class Arima Kinen. Mejiro Ryan's
culminating race is about to begin!
